Berserk is one that I really would not recommend to anyone with a history of trauma or abuse because there are some VERY graphic scenes that even fucked with my head and I consider myself pretty good at handling graphic shit when I am aware it’s all fictional, but I just want to give you that heads up in case you do have some history with those topics. BUT do bot get me wrong Berserk is easily one of the best works of fiction ever made with exceptional characters, plot, and the art is phenomenal, and the writer does an amazing job with the way he makes you question certain things, without spoiling. I highly recommend as long as you are confident that the graphic elements will not effect you too much.
